working_features: Reads seed URLs from a plaintext file via --seeds flag
Configurable depth via --depth (default 2)
Configurable page limit via --limit (default 100)
Configurable workers via --workers (default 5)
Thread-based concurrency with work queue and locks
Fetching with urllib and configurable timeout
HTML parsing using html.parser
Extracts all anchor href links and adds to crawl queue
URL normalization, fragment stripping, deduplication
Fetches and parses robots.txt per domain
Obeys Disallow rules and Crawl-delay with rate limiting
Extracts visible text, strips scripts and styles
Builds inverted index with stemmed terms and term frequencies
TF-IDF scoring for ranking
Text normalization: lowercasing, punctuation removal, stopword filtering
Index persists to JSON after crawl
--load-index loads existing index without recrawling
REST API server starts with --serve on configurable port
GET /search?q= returns ranked JSON results with title, url, score, snippet
GET /search?q=&limit=N limits results
GET /stats returns pages crawled, unique terms, index size, crawl duration
GET /crawl triggers async crawl job, returns job_id
GET /crawl/{job_id} returns job status and progress
Static search.html generated with fetch-based search UI
HTML interface displays clickable title, URL, score, bold-wrapped snippet
Graceful error handling of HTTP errors, timeouts, SSL, malformed HTML
Skips non-HTML content by Content-Type
Live crawl progress line updating in terminal
Summary report with pages, terms, top 10 linked domains, elapsed time
